claims.statement: A nonzero original-coordinate scalar pivot plus a Schur cross block with determinant aggregate E_k and regularized-determinant parameter q closes bounded density whenever k>q; the explicit bound is C(q,k,r)|d|^{-1/2}E_k^{-1/(4k)} for max(1,2q/k)<r<2.
Without a leverage assumption, E_3>0 in the Schur cross block implies ||p_Q||inf <= 17.315056318 |d|^{-1/2} E_3^{-1/12}.
The new square-pivot proof establishes essential boundedness only; it does not establish a continuous representative under the full hypotheses.
The bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis has not yet been reduced exhaustively to the new pivot/aggregate branches or other completed bank mechanisms.
